resolution: file-level + agent-message intent (ATIF exposes agent messages, not per-step read tool calls; ranges unavailable -> honest coarse resolution, never fabricated)

taxonomy.EXACT_REVERIFY: agent message indicates re-reading a file the witness covered, for the same evidence
taxonomy.CONTAINING_REVERIFY: agent reads the file plus broader surrounding context
taxonomy.PARTIAL_REVERIFY: partial overlap of the witnessed file
taxonomy.NO_REVERIFY: answers from the supplied witness without re-reading

materially_broader: agent seeks additional source beyond the supplied witness (narrated broader reads / extra files)
signal: agent message text intent + total_steps + prompt-token growth (a re-read pulls file bytes into context)
